description:
Speak, don't type

Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
New insights for your dictation

You can now see your dictation activity from day to day as dictating becomes a more consistent part of your work, leaving more attention for your thoughts.
- Your active days and streaks: See how many days you've been active, the streak you're on now, and your longest streak so far.
- Your usage heatmap: Get a closer view of your dictation activity across days and weeks, from steady periods to times when it picks back up after a break or grows more active.
Keep the momentum going and make every day count. Thanks for using Typeless.
